gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate co-parenting apps that help with scheduling between two parents.

questions.title: How many children are you scheduling for?
questions.description: Understand the number of children involved to assess app complexity needed.

questions.title: What is your current custody arrangement type?
questions.description: Determine whether the arrangement is 50/50, primary/secondary, or another split.

questions.title: What specific scheduling problem are you trying to solve?
questions.description: Identify the core pain point, such as missed handoffs, last-minute changes, or holiday planning.

questions.title: Do you need messaging features inside the app?
questions.description: Find out if in-app communication between co-parents is a requirement.

questions.title: Is a free app acceptable or will you pay?
questions.description: Establish the budget constraint, whether free-only or open to paid subscriptions.

questions.title: Does the other parent need to actively use the app?
questions.description: Determine if both parties must engage with the app or just one parent.

questions.title: Do you need a record for legal or court purposes?
questions.description: Assess whether documented logs or exportable history are required for legal use.
